scope: Alpha recalibration on the 18 FP32 points of runs/final-validation-20260912 at C=0.90/0.95/0.99; quality phases with the v3 library; timing prepared for the rebased library, not run here.
fixed_ef: reused: C=0.99 from runs/final-validation-20260912 (calibrated in final-development-20260911), C=0.90/0.95 from runs/early-stop-v3-coverage-c90-c95-20261013; see fixed-points.json
selection_rule: rule C: on calibration at the fixed ef, fewest mean distance computations among alphas a such that a and every larger grid alpha have coverage >= C_cal and mean paired loss + 2 SE <= 0.005 (loss = fixed recall - alpha recall per query, SE = sample sd / sqrt(n)); ties -> larger alpha; ef <= 1.25 k -> fixed (rebased library skips early stop); none -> fixed

comparison_rules.rule_b: rule C without the 2 SE margin (mean paired loss <= 0.005)
comparison_rules.old: alpha recorded by the earlier campaign for the same point and tier
comparison_rules.default: alpha 1.5 at k=10, 1.15 at k=100; skipped where ef <= 1.25 k

validation_rule: held-out: fixed coverage >= C; early stop coverage >= C and mean recall loss <= 0.005. The held-out queries were already used once to evaluate the earlier alpha choices; the DBpedia fresh queries were used once, at k100/R95 only.
recall: distance-based: hit when exact angular distance <= k-th true neighbour distance + 2e-6

timing.aggregation: median of four batch statistics per arm
timing.arms: reference = upstream main fixed ef; candidate = rebased library with the rule C alpha

amendments.made_after: the first held-out run of rules C, B, old and default (validate and fresh phases; REPORT.md of that run)
amendments.reason: At C=0.99 the coverage side had no margin: on the calibration queries the fixed ef sits exactly at C_cal, so rule C picks the smallest alpha that happened to add zero calibration failures. DBpedia k100-r95 then added 7 held-out failures against a slack of 5.
amendments.rule: rule C+m: take the rule C alpha on the full calibration set, then use the smallest grid alpha >= 1 + (alpha_C - 1) * (1 + m); m = 0.05 at C=0.90 and C=0.95, m = 0.25 at C=0.99. Points that are fixed or auto-off under rule C stay so.
amendments.margin_choice: Cross-validation on the calibration queries only (source/cv_margin.py; output source/cv_margin.json and cv_margin.txt; earlier version source/cv_margin_v1.py): 300 random 2/3 vs 1/3 splits of each point's calibration queries; rule C on the 2/3; margin m applied; checked on the other third (fail = added failures above C_cal - C, or mean loss above 0.5 points). m = the smallest margin whose mean failure probability over the tier's points is at most 2.5%: C=0.90 3.9% at m=0 -> 0.8% at m=0.05; C=0.95 4.0% -> 0.8%; C=0.99 12.1% -> 2.1% at m=0.25 (3.9% at m=0.20). Cohere k10-r95 at C=0.99 stays near 34% at any margin because a single calibration query decides its boundary.
amendments.held_out_use: The held-out sets and the DBpedia fresh queries are looked at a second time for rule C+m. m was fixed before this second look and is not changed after it.
